metas.name: Pyaar Prema Kalyanam
metas.description: When a bride refuses to leave her family home after marriage, her husband must find out if he can adjust to life under his in-laws' roof.

metas.name: Chompoo: Lost​ &​ Forgotten​
metas.description: When a young girl vanishes from a remote village, the frantic police hunt become a media frenzy. But who turned a suspected criminal into a celebrity?

metas.name: Irumudi
metas.description: An alcoholic with a violent past—living peacefully with his daughter beside a waterfall—decides to take Ayyappa Deeksha (a 41-day spiritual vow and period of intense austerity) at her request.

metas.name: Kelsey Cook: Happy Hour
metas.description: In this candid and clever stand-up special, Kelsey Cook explores "hangxiety," relives a plane bathroom nightmare and breaks down dating a literal Chad.

metas.name: Freefall: A Reckoning for Boeing
metas.description: Following the highly publicized death of Boeing whistleblower John Barnett, the investigation continues into the once-iconic aviation giant, uncovering startling new revelations and insider accounts in the wake of a deepening corporate crisis..

metas.name: My Best Friend, His Girlfriend and Me
metas.description: Olli and Matze are best friends living, working and planning to travel the world together — until Matze's romance with Rebecca turns it all upside down.

metas.name: Vishwanath & Sons
metas.description: A celebrated Olympian shooter travels to America looking for a donor to help his sick child — but unexpected romance complicates his search.

metas.name: This, That, and Everything in Between
metas.description: A TV writer returns home to her estranged mother, igniting chaos as they navigate painful secrets and the  complexities of their dysfunctional family.

metas.name: Don't Say Good Luck
metas.description: Sophie Birenbaum is ready for the spotlight as the lead in her high school musical—until she's suddenly facing more drama at home than on the stage.

metas.name: Nando Between Two Worlds - A Sintonia Film
metas.description: Caught between family life and his obligations to the criminal underworld, Nando faces an impossible choice about where his true loyalties lie.

metas.name: Sacrifice
metas.description: At a glitzy Greek island charity gala, a down-on-his-luck movie star lands the heroic role of a lifetime when a volcanic doomsday cult takes him hostage.

metas.name: Rory Scovel: Show Must Go On
metas.description: With a hypothetical home invasion, a biblical reenactment, and his late dad's final wish, Rory Scovel delivers unrelenting laughs in this raucous stand-up special filmed at The Neptune in Seattle, Washington.

metas.name: Ohh My Dog
metas.description: In Assam, 14-year-old Apu embarks on a desperate quest to rescue his beloved dog, Momo, after he is kidnapped. Elsewhere, in Bihar, a devoted dog named Oscar sets out on a perilous journey to find his kidnapped owner, a 15-year-old child labourer. As their journeys unfold, it becomes clear that the two kidnappings may be connected to a larger, sinister plan.

metas.name: THE RIBBON HERO
metas.description: When the monstrous Nergal devastates her kingdom, Princess Sapphire reawakens as the Ribbon Hero and fights to save her new home from the same dark fate.

metas.name: G.D.N
metas.description: G.D. Naidu overcomes challenges and defies a repressive colonial regime to become one of India's greatest innovators.

metas.name: Korean Kanakaraju
metas.description: Possessed by a Korean spirit, Kanakaraju must navigate his new supernatural identity to protect his family and solve the spirit's murder.

metas.name: The Last House
metas.description: A family suddenly sealed inside their home must work together to survive against dwindling resources and the ominous threat keeping them trapped.

metas.name: Big Chicken: A Fast Food Conspiracy
metas.description: In a bold 28-day experiment, comedian Mo Gilligan tours the UK and US on a fried chicken diet to uncover the impact of the craving — and industry behind it.

metas.name: Inside the Trustor Scandal
metas.description: For the first time since 1997, Joachim Posener finally emerges from hiding and allows himself to be interviewed about his life and the Trustor affair. Twenty-seven years ago, he disappeared without a trace, and ever since, he has been on the international most wanted list. Now, Karin af Klintberg searches for him to find out how he lives and where he's been hiding all these years. But perhaps above all, to uncover what everyone is wondering: Was he guilty? Through new and opposing testimonies from never-before-heard voices, Karin simultaneously continues the search for the truth about the coup. How could five people swindle 600 million kr and still go free? And where did the money actually go?

metas.name: Storm on Sesame Street
metas.description: As a big storm approaches, Elmo and friends work together to get ready. After it passes, Sesame Street looks different — and everyone pitches in to help.

metas.name: Newton's 3rd Law
metas.description: Follows an investigation into a double murder in 1999, with unexpected characters roped into the case as they search for justice amid intrigue and secrets.

metas.name: A Child of My Own
metas.description: Desperate for a baby and burdened by family and societal expectations, a woman fakes a pregnancy and gets tangled in a crime.

metas.name: Mary Beth Barone: Galaxy Brain
metas.description: Is an ex-best friend the worst ex? Can dating apps save democracy? What's with NYPD merch? Mary Beth Barone has all the answers in this witty special.

metas.name: Instadocs: The Prediction Games
metas.description: Prediction markets let anyone bet on anything, from the World Cup to alien invasions. "Instadocs" investigates the explosive rise of global betting.

metas.name: Heartstopper: Ending on a Hi
metas.description: After the ending of the hit Netflix series “Heartstopper”, this special combines never-before-seen behind-the-scenes footage, cast and crew interviews, larger cultural commentary, and fan input.

metas.name: The Truthers
metas.description: After her mother's sudden death, Ruth returns to her hometown and reunites with her father, whose odd behavior makes her question what really happened.

metas.name: Love in Slow Motion
metas.description: When Haya's best friend Jawad gets engaged, her chronically-single world unravels — because who knew true love could be hiding in the friend zone?

metas.name: A Toxic Love Story
metas.description: A string of threatening emails escalates into a revenge plot involving a newly married US marshal and his ex-girlfriend.

metas.name: Elize: Shadows of a Woman
metas.description: In this retelling of a real case, a former escort discovers her wealthy husband's infidelity and struggles to cope as betrayal poisons their marriage.

metas.name: The Debt Collector
metas.description: Tormented by past mistakes and a terminal diagnosis, an ex-debt collector returns to the underworld to protect the victims of a violent organization.

metas.name: 72 HOURS
metas.description: To save his career, a 40-year-old ad exec joins a crew of twentysomethings for a wild Miami bachelor party after they mistakenly add him to a group chat.

metas.name: Heartstopper Forever
metas.description: It's a new school year for the Truham-Higgs gang. As Nick and Charlie's relationship deepens, their thoughts turn to life after the last bell rings.

metas.name: Me Before Me
metas.description: A young student battling pressure, panic and a demanding father uses a class project to discover that truth — not trophies — might finally set him free.

metas.name: Miguel Ángel Blanco: The 48 Hours That Changed Spain
metas.description: This documentary explores how Miguel Ángel Blanco's 1997 abduction turned fear into collective resistance and shaped Spain's fright Against ETA terrorism.

metas.name: Shipwrecked: Nightmare at Sea
metas.description: Never-before-seen footage and survivor accounts trace the 2012 shipwreck of a luxury cruise and the disaster that ensued, in this immersive documentary.

metas.name: Ikka
metas.description: With a loved one's life at stake, a celebrated lawyer must defend a man he suspects is guilty — battling his conscience every step of the way.

metas.name: Idhayam Murali
metas.description: A young man navigates the complexities of unrequited love, finding that even as years pass and life takes unexpected turns, certain emotions remain deeply embedded in his heart.

metas.name: Dhamaal 4
metas.description: The Dhamaal boys are back for another treasure hunt, facing hilarious challenges in their quest for the Treasure of Life.

metas.name: Gail Daughtry and the Celebrity Sex Pass
metas.description: After her fiance sleeps with his celebrity crush, Kansas hairdresser Gail heads to Hollywood to even the score with her own famous fantasy — Jon Hamm.

metas.name: Nothing to Lose
metas.description: She gave everything to become a mother, so when her young son falls ill, Jada will stop at  nothing to find a donor and save him — no matter the cost.

metas.name: Jeff Arcuri: Nice to Meet You
metas.description: Jeff Arcuri's rapid-fire wit is nonstop as he balances outrageous jokes with heartfelt reflections on making his wife laugh during her cancer journey.

metas.name: One Piece Heroines
metas.description: After failing to stop the thieves due to ill-fitting shoes, Nami storms into the shop where she bought them for a refund. However, the head designer offers to make her a new pair from scratch on one condition: she must walk in their upcoming fashion show.

metas.name: Baby Do Die Do
metas.description: A deaf and mute serial killer in Mumbai can only hear her dead sister's voice as she commits murders for mysterious reasons.

metas.name: Gatta Kusthi 2
metas.description: Picks up after the first film, with Veera and Keerthi balancing parenthood and Keerthi's wrestling career, featuring a role reversal where Veera takes on more domestic responsibilities.

metas.name: 23 000 Lives
metas.description: A group of young people sets sail for the Mediterranean to save the lives of refugees — a mission that puts their ideas of law and justice to the test.

metas.name: Rao Bahadur
metas.description: Plagued by guilt and fear, an eccentric aristocrat retreats into his ancestral manor, creating an alternate world that deeply blurs reality and imagination.

metas.name: Alpha
metas.description: When Sita, a highly trained assassin raised in isolation as a super-soldier by a rogue commander, discovers the dark truth about her family and her stolen childhood, she teams up with her long lost sister to take down her creator and his illicit military program.

metas.name: Louis C.K.: Ridiculous
metas.description: From a bee getting shot in New York City to paying strangers to take his aging father, Louis C.K. unleashes the ridiculous thoughts in his mind.

metas.name: Enola Holmes 3
metas.description: Adventure follows detective Enola Holmes to Malta, where her plans to tie the knot unravel when Sherlock's disappearance plunges her into a perilous case.

metas.name: Con City
metas.description: Saravana, Mithra, Jacky, and Janaki, are skilled con artists hiding out as an ordinary family in Mulki, Karnataka. Their quiet life shatters when a young boy in their care is kidnapped, forcing them to use their old hustles one last time.

metas.name: Ryan Hamilton: This Just Hit Me
metas.description: Leave it to Ryan Hamilton to get hit by a bus and have the last laugh — whether it's falling for his anesthesiologist or a dispensary trip with his mom.

metas.name: Voicemails for Isabelle
metas.description: A young woman's hilariously confessional voicemails to her late sister are unknowingly redirected to a stranger, who begins to fall in love from afar.

metas.name: RADWIMPS 20th Anniversary Live Tour
metas.description: RADWIMPS celebrates 20 years since their major debut with this concert film, captured during their 17-show nationwide anniversary tour.

metas.name: Cocktail 2
metas.description: A vacation in Sicily forces longtime partners Diya and Kunal to question their love and commitment after they reunite with Diya's old friend Ally.

metas.name: GOAT Pandemonium Ge on all tempo
metas.description: After his hit show "GOAT," Ge Pamungkas is back with fresh material — exploring love, marriage and the battle of the sexes in this comedy special.

metas.name: Here the Whole Time
metas.description: An insecure teenager's vacation plans are ruined by an unexpected visitor: his neighbor and school crush who will spend two weeks sleeping at his house. The days that promised peace, tranquility and epic series marathons end up bringing a whirlwind of feelings and unresolved issues.

metas.name: Little Brother
metas.description: A tightly wound realtor's picture-perfect life gets an extreme makeover when his lovably chaotic "little brother" suddenly reappears.

metas.name: Husbands in Action
metas.description: A detective teams up with his ex-wife's new husband to chase down her kidnappers. Can this unlikely duo put aside their differences for one wild rescue?

metas.name: Stop! That! Train!
metas.description: Best friends and train stewardesses Tess and DeeDee trade their dreary shifts on the Stank Rail for the glitzy Glamazonian Express. However, when a catastrophic Stormaganza threatens to crash the high-speed train into Celebration, Florida, the duo in coach must join forces with the snobby first-class attendants, a hot but dimwitted co-conductor, and fabulous US President Judy Gagwell to save the day.

metas.name: In the Hand of Dante
metas.description: A Vatican priest discovers Dante's original Divine Comedy manuscript. When asked to authenticate it, writer Nick Tosches steals it, while a parallel story follows Dante's quest to create his masterpiece.

metas.name: Maternal Instinct
metas.description: Police pull over a woman who claims she just gave birth. But the baby — and the blood — aren't hers. Twisted lies unravel in this true-crime documentary.

metas.name: Warkop DKI: ViRaLiN dOoOoNg..!!
metas.description: Three best friends, Dono, Kasino, and Indro, want to get quickly rich by becoming content creators. After numerous failed attempts, they try making a horror-drama video in a remote village. However, their fake plan turns into reality when they are actually haunted by vengeful spirits. To survive, they must uncover the spirits' tragic pasts and help them get justice. Although their horror project fails, their hilarious failed videos make them viral and famous.

metas.name: Garuda: Dare to Dream
metas.description: A thirteen-year-old boy battling severe chronic asthma refuses to abandon his ambitions of joining the Indonesian National Youth Football Team, finding an extraordinary path to athletic rehabilitation through the intervention of a mystical Garuda entity and the strategic support of the head coach's daughter.

metas.name: Main Vaapas Aaunga
metas.description: Haunted by a childhood romance and recollections of love lost during the 1947 Partition of India, 95-year-old Ishar Singh Grewal shares his story with his grandson Nirvair, the past unfolding through memories of migration, longing, and a romance that endures across generations.

metas.name: Kijsada Paradise
metas.description: A friend who goes missing in an abandoned amusement park sets the friendship of a group of teenagers to a challenge as they encounter conflict and secrets along the way.

metas.name: Project Baby
metas.description: The story follows Sandy, a 30-something advertising executive who, fearing her biological clock is ticking, launches "Project Baby"—a step-by-step mission to conceive a child on her own terms with a no-strings-attached donor. She selects Migo, a sensitive artist, but quickly realizes that meticulous plans can't account for human emotion.

metas.name: Chris & Martina: The Final Set
metas.description: Tennis legends Chris Evert and Martina Navratilova reflect on their parallel journeys to sports stardom while delving into their rivalry and friendship, especially as the duo continue to support each other through their shared experience of cancer treatment.

metas.name: Sing Geetham
metas.description: In an isolated village, young Prathap seeks opportunity but enters a world of deception. Drawn into uncontrollable forces, he's caught between progress and preservation, testing his beliefs and purpose.

metas.name: Colors of Evil: Black
metas.description: Investigating the disappearance of children in a remote Polish town, prosecutor Leopold Bilski must unravel a sinister local legend before it's too late.

metas.name: Tony Hinchcliffe: Man of the People
metas.description: Tony Hinchcliffe takes center stage to prove no topic is too taboo and nothing is off-limits — not even the audience — in this razor-sharp special.

metas.name: Carolina Caroline
metas.description: A young woman, desperate to leave her small town, runs away with a charming con man, embarking on a crime and passion-filled journey through the Southeast to find her estranged mother.

metas.name: The Marked Woman
metas.description: When a woman is found in a shipping container with no memory of who she is, two detectives race to figure out her identity — and who wants her dead.

metas.name: Poldi
metas.description: Footballer, entrepreneur, fan favorite and true community hero — Lukas Podolski reflects on his journey and what comes next in this intimate documentary.

metas.name: The Murder of Rachel Nickell
metas.description: A young mother is killed in broad daylight on London's Wimbledon Common — in front of her toddler. This documentary examines the yearslong murder case.

metas.name: Maa Behen
metas.description: When trouble knocks on her door, a mother and her estranged daughters attempt to cover up a crime in a nosy colony where no secret is safe.

metas.name: Office Romance
metas.description: Jackie, President and CEO of Air Cruz, runs a tight ship in her business, including a rigid anti-fraternization policy for all her employees. When a new sexy lawyer begins working for her, that policy becomes very tested.

metas.name: Wild Sing
metas.description: Twenty years after a scandal tears apart a popular 2000s K‑pop trio, the three reunite for a one-off gig — if they can overcome one snag after another.

metas.name: Peddi
metas.description: In a village that doesn't officially exist, a laborer's unmatched athletic talent becomes his weapon to fight for his people's right to be recognized.

metas.name: AFI Life Achievement Award: A Tribute to Eddie Murphy
metas.description: Comedy trailblazer Eddie Murphy celebrates his legendary film career in this star-studded tribute filmed live in Los Angeles.

metas.name: HOMONCULUS
metas.description: If suddenly, from one day to the next, we could no longer see our reflections—never again seeing our own eyes, nose, face, or ourselves—what would it be like?

metas.name: Instadocs: Alex Murdaugh, Unconvicted
metas.description: Why was Alex Murdaugh's conviction overturned? The debut of "Instadocs" digs into stunning allegations of jury interference in his double murder trial.

metas.name: The Breadwinner
metas.description: After his wife Katie lands a once-in-a-lifetime deal on Shark Tank that takes her on a prolonged business trip - lifelong breadwinner Nate Wilcox now has to fend for his family as a first-time stay-at-home dad.

metas.name: Mononoke the Movie: Chapter III - The Curse of the Serpent
metas.description: When tragedy strikes within the walls of the Ōoku, twisted human passions and festering grudges spawn the Medicine Seller's most fearsome opponent yet.

metas.name: Susana and Elvira: No Plan B
metas.description: Susana and Elvira, two former best friends, reunite after two years apart to organize the celebrity wedding of the year.

metas.name: Blast
metas.description: A seemingly ordinary family must unleash their hidden martial arts skills when they clash with a ruthless criminal gang tied to corruption and violence.

metas.name: The Furious: Pertaruhan Maruah
metas.description: When YouTuber-boxer Danial insults their late father's name, brothers Firdaus and Hakim reunite - one fighting for redemption, the other for revenge - in a battle that will decide not just who wins, but what remains of The Furious legacy.

metas.name: Us in the End
metas.description: Cisco and Cheska, a long-term couple, embark on a final "break-up trip" to decide whether to let go or fight for their relationship after years of growing apart due to conflicting ambitions.

metas.name: Kylie - Tension Tour Live
metas.description: It's time to hit the dancefloor as pop superstar Kylie Minogue shares a vibrant, exclusive behind-the-scenes look at her smash 2025 Tension World Tour.

metas.name: Untold UK: Vinnie Jones
metas.description: This is the story of Vinnie Jones's rise, fall, and comeback against odds – and red cards – from one of football's most notorious hard men to FA cup winner.

metas.name: Adili Idola Celebrity Roast: Fedi Nuril
metas.description: Actor Fedi Nuril takes the hot seat as he faces hilarious jokes from a panel of six comedians and celebrities through the “Trilogy of Laughter”.

metas.name: Mexico 86
metas.description: When a last-minute chance to host the 1986 World Cup appears, a cunning Mexican bureaucrat, armed with nothing but guts and audacity, cons his way through FIFA to beat the United States, but in a country of power games, every victory has a price.

metas.name: Ladies First
metas.description: An arrogant but charismatic ladies' man finds his life of money, power and casual flings upended when he wakes up in a parallel world dominated by women.

metas.name: Untold UK: Liverpool's Miracle of Istanbul
metas.description: At half-time in the 2005 champion league final Liverpool were 3-0 down. What happened next made football history -​ as players recall in this documentary.

metas.name: Wanda Sykes: Legacy
metas.description: Wanda Sykes returns to her alma mater with a fearlessly funny takedown of everything from the state of the world to the cultural clash over washcloths.

metas.name: Bride of the Year
metas.description: When Lienkie's dream of budding a family of her own come crashing down, she hatches a devious plan to win "Bride of the Year" and get back at her ex.

metas.name: Kartavya
metas.description: With his family's safety at stake and menacing threats closing in, a police officer must decide how far he'll go to uphold his duty.

metas.name: Pati Patni Aur Woh Do
metas.description: A seemingly perfect marriage in Prayagraj takes an unexpected turn when one decision leads to a chain of misunderstandings, suspicion, and comedic chaos.

metas.name: LifeHack
metas.description: A thrill-seeking gang of teen hackers must pull off their riskiest heist yet when a woman blackmails them into targeting her crypto-billionaire father.

metas.name: The Crash
metas.description: A teen slams her car into a building, killing her boyfriend and his friend. What seems like a tragic accident becomes a murder case.
